topic_resolutions.finding: D funds must be transferred to the trading account for securities trading; display selection alone does not transfer funds.
The broker-supplied Form1042-S is English-only; this says nothing about translated guidance.
Personal-data changes are submitted for review; execution follows checking. The specified route is for eligible trading accounts.
Data confirmation can gate withdrawals. No unlock SLA, guaranteed withdrawal, automatic resumption or mandatory resubmission rule was found.
Login reservation/reuse after account closure is not established. Do not call it true or false from these pages.
Use Margin is an order setting; the article says its enabled state persists for future trades until disabled.
Order-entry margin consent and ongoing borrowing/collateral are separate. No universal no-effect or forced-close guarantee for existing positions was established.
Official routes identify the active tariff through a report and a context-qualified Tariff view. Under-name placement and past-period header semantics remain unverified.
Users select a reporting period; this alone does not establish the time basis of every report field.
